immediate.judge: I will make an immediate judgment based on the matters clarified so far. We will proceed directly to the verdict.

conditional.judge: I will first present a conditional mediation proposal that separates each person's responsibility. The Officetel visits and early-morning calls, the personal slush-fund withdrawal, and the joint savings cancellation will not be bundled into one issue.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: If this is conditional mediation, I can accept that. But the facts about the Officetel visits and early-morning calls need to be clarified first, or the same suspicion will keep coming back.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: I can accept the conditional terms as well. But please keep my 30-million-won personal-fund withdrawal and my wife's cancellation of the joint savings as two separate matters.

postpone.judge: I will first settle only the facts that can be confirmed now and reserve the rest. I will separately assess responsibility for what was concealed and responsibility for acting first on one's own judgment.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: I can accept reserving a decision. But the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls at least have to be confirmed today, or all that's left is more guesswork.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: I also think the circumstances need a closer look before any hasty conclusion. But please make it clear that reserving a decision is not the same as being cleared.

fact_first.judge: Before discussing a solution, I will clarify the facts. We will first establish the order of the Officetel visits and early-morning calls, the ₩30M personal slush-fund withdrawal, and the joint savings cancellation.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: I agree with sorting out the facts first. At least the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls — please confirm those clearly against the records first.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: If facts come before solutions, I can accept that. But please don't let the studio-apartment visits and late-night calls calcify into a finding of an affair.
